page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords with Latin glosses and Scripture references. Running head centred at top (Hebrew), page number top right. Catchword bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: שַׁבַּת Quievit, Cessavit: Præter. כִּי בוֹ שַׁבַּת Nam in illo quievit, Gen.2.3. שַׁבָּתָה מְדֻהָבָה Cessavit aurea, Jes.14.4. Futur. וַיִּשְׁבֹּת Et quievit, Gen.2.2. Niph. וְנִשְׁבַּת מִבְצָר Et cessabit munitio, Jesa.17. vers.3. וְנִשְׁבְּתוּ גִּלּוּלֵיכֶם Et cessabunt stercorea idola vestra, Ezechiel.6.6. Hiph. הַשְׁבִּית Cessare fecit vel fivit, Abolevit, Sustu-lit, Amovit, Removit, Summovit: Præt. וְהִשְׁבִּית אֶת הַכְּמָרִים Et abolevit atratos sacrificulos, 2.Reg.23.5. וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי גְאוֹן זֵדִים Faciamq; ut cesset fastus superborum, Jesa.13.11. Futur. וַאֲשַׁבִּיתָה מֵאֲנוֹשׁ זִכְרָם Et faciam ut cesset e mortali-bus memoria ipsorum, Deut.32.26.

שַׁבָּת c. Cessatio, Requies, Sabbathum: Dies septi-mus hebdomadæ, Cessationi ab operibus destina-tus, & synec-dochicè Septimana, à septimo die appellata: Quater le-gitur שַׁבָּת, ut tradit Masora Lev.25.6. שֹׁמֵר שַׁבָּת Custodiens sabbathum, Jesa.56.2. Constr. וְהָיְתָה שַׁבַּת הָאָרֶץ Erit requies terræ, Lev.25.6. Aff. שַׁבָּת בִּשַּׁבָּתוֹ Sabbathi in sabbatho suo, Numer.28.10. ubi prius in Pathach desi-nit, cui simile שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּת Sabbatho sabbatho, id est, unicuo-que sabbatho, 1.Par.9.32. וְשַׁבַּתָּה Et sabbathum ejus, Hos.2. v.11. Plur. שַׁבָּתוֹת Sabbatha, Septimanæ: Constr. שַׁבְּתֹת שָׁנִים Septimanas annorum, Levit.25.8. Aff. אֶת שַׁבַּתֹּתֶיהָ Sabbatha sua, Lev.26.34.
שָׁבַת m. Cessatio: שִׁבַּת־מָרִיב [?] Cessatio à lite, Prov.20.3. שְׁבַת Cessatio, Jesa.30.7. Possint hæc etiam esse Infinitivus à שָׁבַב Sedere, Manere. Aff. שִׁבְתּוֹ Cessationem ejus, Exod.21.19.
שַׁבְּתוֹן m. Quies, Requies, Cessatio: שַׁבַּת־קֹדֶשׁ Quies sabbathum sanctum erit, Exod.6. v.23. שַׁבַּת שַׁבָּתוֹן Sabbathum quietis, Exod.35.2.
מִשְׁבָּתִים m.p. Cessationes: Aff. עַל מִשְׁבַּתָּהּ Propter cessa-tiones ejus, Thren.1.7.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some consonants are faint in the scan; those readings are best effort, and the uncertain headword (שִׁבַּת־מָרִיב) is marked [?]. Printed "Ies" read as Jesa/Jes per the i/j rule; "Exod." and "Gen." are as printed. Possible printing error: "Quater legitur" and "Sabbathi" are as printed, not corrected. The Hebrew running head and catchword are read from the scan.
